# shinydashboardPlus

[![R build
status](https://github.com/RinteRface/shinydashboardPlus/workflows/R-CMD-check/badge.svg)](https://github.com/RinteRface/shinydashboardPlus/actions)

[![total](https://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/grand-total/shinydashboardPlus)](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=shinydashboardPlus)

> extensions for shinydashboard

Expand

![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

## Installation

``` r

# for the CRAN version
install.packages("shinydashboardPlus")
# for the latest version
devtools::install_github("RinteRface/shinydashboardPlus")
```

  

[Go to Get Started](articles/shinydashboardPlus.md)

## Motivations

shinydashboardPlus is based on the idea of
[ygdashboard](https://github.com/gyang274/ygdashboard/tree/master/R),
the latter not compatible with shinydashboard (you cannot use
shinydashboard and ygdashboard at the same time). With
shinydashboardPlus you can still work with the shinydashboard classic
functions and enrich your dashboard with all additional functions of
shinydashboardPlus!

## Demo

[here](https://shinylive.io/r/editor/#h=0&code=NobwRAdghgtgpmAXGKAHVA6ASmANGAYwHsIAXOMpMAGwEsAjAJykYE8AKAZwAtaJWAlAB0IdJiw48+rACZQe9IixnDRDZmy69+chUsYyACtQCunVSKn8AgugAitRl1adyMDADNa1OOyFg4AA9YVB9Of1wAAlQoAgBrKABzOEiAXkj-K1l5bkVlYzN-AQEwAF8AXSA)
or run:

``` r

library(shinydashboardPlus)
shinydashboardPlusGallery()
```

# Package index

## Skeleton Functions

Page and header wrappers

- [`dashboardFooter()`](dashboardFooter.md) : Dashboard Footer
- [`dashboardHeader()`](dashboardHeader.md) : Create a header for a
  dashboard page
- [`dashboardPage()`](dashboardPage.md) : Dashboard Page with a right
  sidebar
- [`dashboardSidebar()`](sidebar.md) [`updateSidebar()`](sidebar.md) :
  Create a dashboard sidebar.

## Navbar Functions

Items to insert in the left navbar menu

- [`dashboardUser()`](dashboardUser.md) : Create a dashboard user
  profile.
- [`dashboardUserItem()`](dashboardUserItem.md) : Create a dashboard
  user profile item
- [`dropdownBlock()`](dropdownBlock.md) : Create a dropdown block to
  place in a dashboard header
- [`renderUser()`](renderUser.md) : Create dynamic user output (server
  side)
- [`userOutput()`](userOutput.md) : Create a dynamic user output (client
  side)
- [`taskItem()`](taskItem.md) : Custom taskItem
- [`notificationItem()`](notificationItem.md) : Custom notificationItem
- [`messageItem()`](messageItem.md) : Custom messageItem

## Right Sidebar (controlbar)

Right sidebar elements

- [`dashboardControlbar()`](controlbar.md)
  [`updateControlbar()`](controlbar.md)
  [`controlbarMenu()`](controlbar.md)
  [`controlbarItem()`](controlbar.md)
  [`updateControlbarMenu()`](controlbar.md) : AdminLTE2 dashboard right
  sidebar

## Box functions

Functions that are designed to create new boxes

- [`box()`](box.md) [`updateBox()`](box.md) [`boxDropdown()`](box.md)
  [`boxDropdownItem()`](box.md) [`dropdownDivider()`](box.md)
  [`boxPad()`](box.md) [`descriptionBlock()`](box.md) : Create a box for
  the main body of a dashboard

- [`boxLabel()`](boxLabel.md) :

  Create a label for [box](https://rdrr.io/r/graphics/box.html)

- [`boxSidebar()`](boxSidebar.md) [`updateBoxSidebar()`](boxSidebar.md)
  : Create a sidebar for a box

- [`userBox()`](userBox.md) [`userDescription()`](userBox.md) :
  AdminLTE2 user box

- [`socialBox()`](socialBox.md) [`userBlock()`](socialBox.md)
  [`boxComment()`](socialBox.md) : AdminLTE2 social box

- [`flipBox()`](flipbox.md) [`updateFlipBox()`](flipbox.md) : A flipBox
  based on the W3C example

## Box extra elements

Functions that are designed to be inserted inside boxes

- [`socialBox()`](socialBox.md) [`userBlock()`](socialBox.md)
  [`boxComment()`](socialBox.md) : AdminLTE2 social box
- [`box()`](box.md) [`updateBox()`](box.md) [`boxDropdown()`](box.md)
  [`boxDropdownItem()`](box.md) [`dropdownDivider()`](box.md)
  [`boxPad()`](box.md) [`descriptionBlock()`](box.md) : Create a box for
  the main body of a dashboard
- [`userList()`](userList.md) [`userListItem()`](userList.md) :
  AdminLTE2 user list container
- [`todoList()`](todoList.md) [`todoListItem()`](todoList.md) :
  AdminLTE2 todo list container
- [`navPills()`](navPills.md) [`updateNavPills()`](navPills.md)
  [`navPillsItem()`](navPills.md) : AdminLTE2 nav pill container
- [`productList()`](productList.md)
  [`productListItem()`](productList.md) : AdminLTE2 product list
  container
- [`accordion()`](accordion.md) [`accordionItem()`](accordion.md)
  [`updateAccordion()`](accordion.md) : AdminLTE2 accordion container
- [`timelineBlock()`](timeline.md) [`timelineLabel()`](timeline.md)
  [`timelineItem()`](timeline.md) [`timelineItemMedia()`](timeline.md)
  [`timelineStart()`](timeline.md) [`timelineEnd()`](timeline.md) :
  AdminLTE2 timeline block
- [`boxProfile()`](boxProfile.md) [`boxProfileItem()`](boxProfile.md) :
  AdminLTE2 box profile
- [`userMessages()`](userMessage.md) [`userMessage()`](userMessage.md)
  [`updateUserMessages()`](userMessage.md) : AdminLTE2 user message
  container
- [`userPost()`](userPost.md) [`userPostTagItems()`](userPost.md)
  [`userPostTagItem()`](userPost.md) [`userPostMedia()`](userPost.md) :
  AdminLTE2 user post

## Buttons

new buttons (not action buttons as in shiny! Only for external or
internal link)

- [`appButton()`](appButton.md) : AdminLTE2 special large button
- [`socialButton()`](socialButton.md) : AdminLTE2 social button

## Extra elements

Elements to be placed everywhere

- [`loadingState()`](loadingState.md) : AdminLTE2 loading state element
- [`blockQuote()`](blockQuote.md) : AdminLTE2 block quote
- [`carousel()`](carousel.md) [`carouselItem()`](carousel.md) :
  AdminLTE2 carousel container
- [`dashboardBadge()`](dashboardBadge.md) : AdminLTE2 badge
- [`dashboardLabel()`](dashboardLabel.md) : AdminLTE2 label
- [`starBlock()`](starBlock.md) : AdminLTE2 starBlock
- [`attachmentBlock()`](attachmentBlock.md) : AdminLTE2 attachment
  container
- [`progressBar()`](progressBar.md) : AdminLTE2 vertical progress bar

## CSS extras

Pimp your app

- [`skinSelector()`](skinSelector.md)
  [`skinSelectorItem()`](skinSelector.md) : AdminLTE2 skin selector

## The Gallery

a showcase for shinydashboardPlus

- [`shinydashboardPlusGallery()`](shinydashboardPlusGallery.md) : Launch
  the shinydashboardPlus Gallery
